title: Write a bash script that greets each name in a list.
prompt: Write a bash script that greets each name in a list.
solution_code:
#!/bin/bash
# greet each name
while IFS= read -r name; do
  echo "Hello, $name!"
done < names.txt
explanation: Read names line by line and print a greeting for each one. It runs in linear time.
